title: Relative Bar Data
statement: For arbitrary condensed coefficients $R$ and profinite $H$, use the recorded internal function, bar diagram and compatible derived bar model. Define the real cyclic complex with $R$ in degrees zero and one, all other terms zero and zero differential. For v:$Z$ to $H$, define the unique cochain map from the underived bar of trivial $R$ to this complex: identity under the degree-zero function identification, evaluation at v(+1) in degree one, and zero in degrees at least two, on every generalized profinite section. For EVERY nonnegative equivariant injective resolution I, define the unique underived bar augmentation j into the resolution-zero row of the recorded total, by cochains(I.augmentation^0) followed by the (n,0) total coprojection. Define the small-Hom scalar invariant resolution isomorphism using Q of the resolution and the derived computation unit. Define BarNormalization to be the comparison from scalar invariants to the compatible bar model invariants fixed by their actual inclusions; it exists for every such model. Define eta from the normalized scalar resolution comparison, this invariant comparison, and the existing bar-total augmentation quasi-isomorphism, using canonical extension from natural to integer cochains. Uses [def-sfb-relative-derived-invariants], [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-invariant-bar].
